turns.reply:
Welcome, Ashley! You're in the right place, and taking this first step is huge. Being nervous is completely normal, but we are going to build this up slowly, safely, and at a pace that feels good to you.

Before we jump in, since you're brand new to exercise, it's always a good idea to check with your doctor first if you have any health concerns or medical conditions. 

Today on your plan, we just have a gentle 20-minute walk at an easy pace. It's simply about getting moving and building the habit without beating your body up.
